counterfactual_missing_items: explicit mention of traumatic maculopathy in the medical history
further details on the extent of the lightning strike's impact on the eye
decisive_items: central macular thickening in fundus examination
Intraretinal cystoid changes and subfoveal ellipsoid zone disruption in the right eye
response.rationale: R5 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including central macular thickening and intraretinal cystoid changes. R2 is the runner-up due to its strong support from the outer retinal layer damage, but it lacks the breadth of evidence seen in R5.

rejected.why: narrow focus on cystoid macular edema without considering the broader context of the injury
limited to cataract development without addressing the primary issue of vision loss
overly broad diagnosis of electrical injury to the eye without specifying the effects on the macula
